dom.style: display:none (toggled via .open class to display:flex); position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:10000; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6); align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center; padding-top:15vh

elements.palette: .palette — dialog container centered in overlay. CSS: width:560px, max-height:70vh, background:var(--surface), border-radius:8px, border:1px dashed var(--border), box-shadow:var(--shadow), overflow:hidden, display:flex, flex-direction:column.
elements.input: input.palette-input — search input field. CSS: width:100%, padding:12px 16px, background:transparent, border:none, border-bottom:1px solid var(--border), color:var(--primary), font-family:inherit, font-size:14px, outline:none. Attributes: autocomplete=off, spellcheck=false, placeholder='Search files by name...', aria-label='Search files by name'.
elements.progress: .palette-progress — hidden progress bar during file walk. CSS: display:none, height:2px, background:var(--border). Contains .palette-progress-bar (height:100%, background:var(--accent), width:100%, animation: indeterminate).
elements.results: .palette-results — scrollable result list. CSS: overflow-y:auto, max-height:calc(70vh - 48px).
elements.result_item: .palette-item — single result row. CSS: padding:8px 16px, cursor:pointer, display:flex, justify-content:space-between, align-items:center, font-size:12px, border-bottom:1px solid var(--border). Hover: background:var(--panel). .is-selected: background:var(--panel), color:var(--accent).
elements.result_dir: .palette-item-dir — relative directory path in tertiary color.
elements.empty: .palette-empty — empty/loading/no-results message. CSS: padding:16px, text-align:center, color:var(--tertiary), font-size:12px.
elements.section_header: .palette-section-header — 'RECENT FILES' label. CSS: padding:6px 16px, font-size:9px, font-weight:700, letter-spacing:1.5px, color:var(--accent).

interactions.name: search
interactions.action: Clear pending timer. If input value is empty: clear results, selectedIndex=-1, render recent files. Otherwise: debounce 150ms → performSearch().

interactions.name: perform_search
interactions.action: If files not yet loaded: set loading=true, show progress bar, render 'Searching files...' → walk workspace recursively via IPC fs:readDir (skipping .git, node_modules, .cockpit) → set filesLoaded=true, loading=false, hide progress bar. Then: filter allFiles by name or path includes search term (case-insensitive), slice top 50, set selectedIndex to 0 (or -1 if empty), renderResults().

interactions.name: select_result
interactions.action: If Enter on empty input with recent files: select top recent (or selectedIndex). If Enter with results: select results[selectedIndex]. On select: addRecent(filePath) → save to localStorage → close() → fire onSelectFile(filePath). Mousedown: preventDefault, selectFile(filePath). Mouseenter on item: highlight item by updating selectedIndex and toggling .is-selected across all items.

interactions.name: navigate
interactions.action: Prevent default. moveSelection(direction): clamp selectedIndex within querySelectorAll('.palette-item') range, toggle .is-selected class across all items, scrollIntoView(block:nearest) on selected item.

interactions.name: dismiss
interactions.trigger: Escape keydown on .palette-input or click on .palette-overlay (not .palette)
interactions.action: close() → overlay.classList.remove('open'), clear pending search timer.

interactions.name: first_load
interactions.trigger: First non-empty search input after open
interactions.action: Walk workspace recursively via IPC fs:readDir (skipping .git, node_modules, .cockpit), show progress bar, display 'Searching files...', sort results alphabetically.

states.open_empty: Overlay visible with .open class. Input empty — shows recent files under 'RECENT FILES' header, or 'No recent files. Start typing to search.' if none.
states.open_loading: Overlay visible. Input has value, first search — progress bar visible, results show 'Searching files...'.
states.open_results: Overlay visible. Results rendered — .palette-item rows for top 50 matches, selectedIndex item has .is-selected class.
states.open_no_results: Overlay visible. Search performed but no matches — shows 'No matching files' via .palette-empty.

aria: aria-label='Search files by name' on input
